label: Declassified

szenen.text: In 1953, the CIA helped *overthrow* Iran's elected leader.
The plan had a code name: *Operation TPAJAX.*
It used propaganda and *bribed* members of parliament.
The goal: remove Prime Minister Mossadegh and *back the Shah.*

szenen.text: For decades, the U.S. role stayed *officially secret.*

szenen.text: Early document releases had CIA parts *blacked out.*
In 2013, the CIA's internal history was *finally released.*

archiv.datei: File:Aerial view of CIA headquarters, Langley, Virginia 14271v.jpg

szenen.text: The CIA now calls the coup *undemocratic.*
Why do some secrets take *60 years* to confirm? Follow for more files.
